title: How to Survive a Psyop: Homepage Safety Decision Tree
purpose: Provide clear, low-cognitive-load choices to a person who may be panicking, frightened, confused or overwhelmed. Prioritise immediate safety and avoid impulsive responses. The visitor need not determine the cause of their experience.
audience: Visitors seeking simple guidance during a frightening or confusing experience
principles: Prioritise immediate danger and access to emergency help
Use simple binary choices at critical steps
Reveal more information only when the visitor chooses it
Provide a clear path for someone who feels unable to ignore the situation
Discourage confrontation, impulsive actions and real-time analysis of provocations
Make the first steps usable without identifying an adversary, deciding anyone's intent or reading the chapter catalogue
Offer factual recording, later reflection and reporting through appropriate channels

views.description: Additional practical instructions: record only when convenient, avoid engaging with provocation, decide on reporting when calm, and seek appropriate help.

A particularly prominent fallback for someone who feels unable to disregard events. Ask what would happen if they did nothing; seek police help for danger; otherwise look back over the last fortnight up to yesterday rather than reacting to current events.
instructions: Consider whether doing nothing creates danger. If so, contact the police; use 999 for immediate danger.
Discuss what has been going in the last fortnight with ChatGPT using the link below.

Start at the beginning, think back a fortnight, and only go up to yesterday. Has anything strange happened? Do your best to ignore whatever is currently bothering you and see if the events of the last week or two put things in perspective.
If ChatGPT advises you to respond directly to anyone about anything, that is bad advice. Don't talk to anyone apart from your family.

reference_material.description: The wider chapter catalogue and technical discussion are optional; they are not prerequisites for using the initial decision tree.

interpretation_note: This JSON documents the site's intended navigation and interaction design. It does not establish that a psychological operation is occurring or guarantee that any response is right in every circumstance. In an emergency, prioritise safety and appropriate services.
